verdict.rationale: Orrick is a law firm whose Tech Studio offers self-service legal tools and document generators. It is not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server, API, or agent connectivity; the probe even found no llms.txt (HTTP 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
